arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَلَدٗاۗ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥۚ بَلۡ عِبَادٞ مُّكۡرَمُونَ

en.text: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they[882] are [but] honored servants.
en.footnotes: [882] Those they claim to be "children" of Allāh, such as the angels, Ezra, Jesus, etc.
